description: Consommations énergétiques des ouvrages d'ASSAINISSEMENT is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Lorient Agglomération. This excel file presents the consumption of sanitation works (refoulement stations, lift stations, pumping stations, etc.) of Lorient Agglomeration (energy consumption in kWh, financial costs, CO2 emissions) since 2011. Coverage: Lorient Agglomération. The portal shows the English title as "Energy consumption of ASSAINISSMENT works" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Lorient Agglomération. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLS. The listing shows 2015-11-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
